title: GANGPLANK MATCHUPS GUIDE 14.10 by EUNE rank 2
author: Wielki B

Aatrox.summary: Run Fleet Footwork with Bone Plating, or First Strike if confident; he can easily kill you in lane. Buy anti-heal and Swiftness Boots, and dodge his Q sweet spots and W. Poke heavily; you can win a duel when he is around 40% health and you are full.

Akali.summary: Take First Strike and poke her with Q and barrels. Once you have hit her with your passive auto, you can see her inside her shroud.

Akshan.summary: His range and passive make it tricky, though only a strong Akshan makes it hard. Fleet Footwork with Second Wind is the safe setup.

Camille.summary: A skill matchup. Her passive shield does not block your passive, so reset it often and poke her down; with a small lead you can win the duel.

Darius.summary: You can win early: take Ignite and poke him until Flash, passive auto, Q and Ignite can kill. Avoid his pull. Once he has ult, only fight after poking him below half health.

DrMundo.summary: Easy: take First Strike and Cut Down, dodge his cleavers, and kill him early. Buy anti-heal but do not rush it.

Fiora.summary: Hard against a good Fiora. Poke her and only fight when she is below half health and you have anti-heal. Grasp and Bone Plating work, and you can bait her riposte with an emote-style animation cancel.

Garen.summary: Avoid losing health and stay near or under your tower; below half health he can Flash-Q, Ignite and ult you.

Gnar.summary: Take Fleet Footwork and Second Wind and avoid his poke. You rarely win a duel unless he misplays.

Gwen.summary: A good Gwen is very hard to handle; farm near your tower. First Strike is recommended.

Illaoi.summary: Dodge her E and walk out of range if it hits. Take First Strike if you dodge well, otherwise Fleet. Never fight inside her ult; with Ignite you can try to kill her before level 6.

Irelia.summary: You win with good play before she completes Blade of the Ruined King. Avoid overextending; Ignite and Plated Steelcaps help.

Jax.summary: Take First Strike and Bone Plating, and use W to cleanse his stun. Keep poking and you win easily.

Jayce.summary: He out-damages you at range during laning, but he can be killed with careful play. Fleet Footwork with Second Wind.

Kayle.summary: Kill her before level 6, since it gets harder afterward. Do not push into her so your jungler can punish her. First Strike with Gathering Storm.

Kennen.summary: Take Fleet Footwork and Second Wind, dodge his shuriken, and poke him; if you are ahead on health you can win the duel.

Kled.summary: Take Bone Plating, dodge his Q, watch for dives and never stay in lane on low health.

Malphite.summary: Rough early if he runs Comet. Take Second Wind and buy armor penetration.

Mordekaiser.summary: Very hard since your W no longer cleanses his ult. Take Bone Plating and stay near your tower after level 6. If you cannot dodge his Q, stand among minions to reduce its damage.

Nasus.summary: His healing outpaces your poke, so you cannot stop him stacking. Freeze near your tower and call for your jungler.

Olaf.summary: Poke him, dodge his axe and avoid his E.

Ornn.summary: Take First Strike and Cut Down; he simply out-stats you. Dying once makes the lane hard, but if he misplays and you kill him, you can duel him later.

Quinn.summary: Take Fleet Footwork and Second Wind, poke her without overextending, and ask for ganks.

Renekton.summary: Take Bone Plating and avoid fighting during his ult unless the kill is certain. With anti-heal and two items you kill him easily.

Riven.summary: Against a skilled Riven the lane feels unplayable; at level 6 she can kill you in seconds. Take Bone Plating and poke her down.

Rumble.summary: Fleet Footwork and Second Wind. Dodge his harpoon and do not walk up at levels 3-4 when his flamethrower hits very hard. Poke him and chase when he is low.

Sett.summary: Take Bone Plating and avoid his E. You can W his ult; do it quickly to avoid the slam damage.

Shen.summary: He hits hard early. W his taunt, poke him, and run First Strike with Cut Down.

Singed.summary: A free farming lane where you can rack up very high CS.

Sion.summary: Avoid his E and Q and respect his passive damage after death. Keep resetting your passive; take First Strike and Cut Down.

TahmKench.summary: Dodge his tongue since he hits hard, and W his ult. First Strike with Cut Down.

Teemo.summary: Fleet with Second Wind or First Strike with Second Wind both work. W cleanses his blind, and with items you one-shot him.

Trundle.summary: Do not overextend; freeze near your tower. Take Bone Plating or Cut Down and buy anti-heal. Poke him but only engage when you are sure to kill him even through his ult.

Tryndamere.summary: With ult he can dive you, so ult yourself if needed and W his slow. Exhaust is an option.

Urgot.summary: Getting hit by his E is usually fatal. You can W his ult recast so you still get pulled but survive. Bone Plating is good.

Vayne.summary: Fleet, Second Wind and Doran's Shield. Farm without losing much health, stay near your tower, poke lightly and ask for ganks; after a few items you one-shot her.

Volibear.summary: Take Cut Down; he deals a lot of damage. Poke him, watch for dives and do not stay low when he has ult.

MonkeyKing.summary: With Ignite at level 6 he can one-shot you, and his early game is strong. Take Bone Plating; hard but winnable.

Yasuo.summary: Annoying but not hard. Bone Plating helps, bait his wind wall with an animation cancel, and you can W his ult.

Yone.summary: Poke him down, respect his W shield during trades, and take Bone Plating.

Yorick.summary: Nearly unwinnable against a competent Yorick: his cage and E take huge chunks of health and his push is strong. You can kill him before level 6, but the lane stays very hard.
